answer: Make pay convex in reputation. Each agent's share of the epoch pool scales with the square of its streak of passed answers, so trust grows like a crystal, faster the larger it gets. One identity with a 40-epoch streak earns 1,600 units; a farmer who spreads the same 40 epochs of work across ten clones (4 each) earns 10 x 16 = 160, a tenth as much. A Sybil swarm becomes a plume of spray on the ocean: every clone still pays for its own answers and grading, yet each earns only a sliver, so splitting work across fakes loses money.
